narrative.overview:
Artwork carries the atmosphere;
controls make browsing and playback clear. Use one coherent type scale, measured
gaps, a restrained orange accent, and dark surfaces. Make the next useful action
easy to find without surrounding every piece of metadata with another card.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Verify the final composited colors, including scrims and translucent selection fills. Normal text needs 4.5:1; large text and essential non-text controls need 3:1. Small white text on orange is not automatically readable. Prefer a white cinematic primary action with dark text, or a dark on-orange label where contrast supports it. Do not lower subtitle/placeholder opacity until it fails.

rules.name: The Scalable Type Rule
rules.body: Match the hierarchy at normal scale, using sp and content-driven heights. Nuvio forces `fontScale = 1f`; LionLibrary must preserve system font scaling. At 200%, titles can wrap, metadata groups can flow and actions can grow. Never shrink text or clip a label to preserve a screenshot's geometry.

dos: Do use this as a measured reference, with source values and proposed changes distinguished. Use the pinned release, not a newer branch's unrelated constants.
Do implement one shared spacing/type/shape system, using Material roles and the installed Android Compose/MVI/navigation skills when code work begins.
Do preserve orange, two folder roots, offline art, stable IDs and every existing scan/playback/history/watchlist contract in AGENT.md.
Do keep the episode list and its controls unchanged during this redesign.
Do test 320/360 dp widths, 1×/1.5×/2× text, long titles, landscape return, tablet/rail layout, TalkBack, RTL, keyboard and missing artwork.
Do verify image transitions at rest and mid-swipe; text and logos must never flash behind each other or drift outside the centered content area.
Do use a licensed bundled family, and explicitly configure every Material type role. Preserve Inter until any replacement's redistribution terms are established.
Do preserve scroll position, search query and filter selection when returning from Details; keep saved state in the existing presentation model.
Do capture before/after screenshots on the same phone/density and compare typography baselines, image ratios, target sizes and empty/error behavior.
donts: Don't treat reference inspection as authorization to implement features now.
Don't introduce Cloud/Profile/accounts, remote discovery, downloads, new folder roots, onboarding or Settings options merely because Nuvio has them.
Don't disable font scaling, copy undersized hit targets or preserve a fixed grid count when captions become unreadable.
Don't add an extra title below an already-labeled image by accident, stretch logos, or render fallback text underneath a loaded transparent logo.
Don't copy rating strips that are part of poster images as if they were a native rating component, or show ratings/services our app does not fetch.
Don't let a floating bar, transparent sticky header or keyboard hide final rows/actions. Safe clearance is a layout requirement, not a screenshot workaround.

Don't copy all Nuvio fonts/code/assets into the app based solely on public repository visibility. The [release repository license](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/blob/1ae5066a4dd5026228625e40082eacc3ada68436/LICENSE) is GPL-3.0; this reference uses observations and measurements, without importing its implementation or artwork into LionLibrary.
